notes: Settings, rebuilt. The overview is now one calm list — a quiet status line, then plain rows separated by hairlines. No cards, no numbered indexes, no noise, and every setting lives on exactly one page. Appearance: your wallpaper now yields a five-swatch palette (dominant, vibrant, deep, light, muted) and those colors lead the whole interface — accents, glows, toggles and selections. Tap a swatch to make it the accent, use its dot to fine-tune that color, or return to the auto palette at any time. The Cover / Main screen switch sits at the top of Background and stays visible on foldables; diagnostics moved into a collapsed section at the bottom.
